comment: Brand color is the one color constant across light AND dark — everything that changes between themes (surface, text) lives in theme/{light,dark}.json instead.

onBrand.comment: Text/icons drawn on top of the brand color need their own guarantee, independent of theme — reusing theme.text failed AA against brand red in both themes (contrast.test.ts caught it: 3.84:1 light, 3.98:1 dark, both below the 4.5:1 minimum).

card.comment: Corner rounding is a brand shape, not a distance function — near-identical across density/*.json on purpose.
